今日要点市场状态MIXED
市场处于两难境地：一方面，美国就业数据疲软出人意料，助长了降息预期；另一方面，科技/AI反弹推动指数创下新高。同时，不断升级的地缘政治风险（伊朗、贸易战、美联储政治化）和大宗商品供应担忧使波动性保持高位。看涨理由建立在AI货币化、机构现金配置和加密货币采用之上；看跌理由则警告债务消化不良、美联储内部分歧以及供应链中断。

AI infrastructure capex boomAI基础设施资本支出繁荣
×11 · 43 步
AI基础设施支出正在加速，大型科技公司资本开支预计2026年同比增长约100%至$730bn，到2028年超过$1tn，推动AI基础设施股票强劲盈利增长，并支持全球（包括中国）AI生态系统。AWS需求可见性延伸至2028年，积压订单$496bn，并有望实现$1tn年收入；管理层将2026年资本开支上调至约$220bn，并预计2027-2028年投资持续处于高位。云AI资本开支带动光器件、半导体测试设备和天然气发电需求；Goldman Sachs指出，肯塔基州一个$100bn数据中心园区需要约400 mmcf/d的天然气吞吐量。

China domestic demand weakness vs easing中国内需疲弱与宽松预期
×7 · 25 步
中国国内需求在多个领域走弱：官方制造业PMI 7月大幅降至49.8，房地产销售7月累计同比恶化至-14.6%，二手房价格7月环比下降0.5%（同比下降9.6%）。7月政治局会议强化宽松措辞，并强调加快落实既定措施；尚有约RMB1.8tn未使用债券额度及新的RMB800bn政策性金融工具，但Goldman预计2026年不会降息。中国7月经济活动走软，钢材需求与产量下降，制造业PMI收缩，房地产成交疲弱。房地产活动指标较2020-21年峰值下降60-80%，财政紧缩贡献了Q1至Q2 GDP放缓的近一半。
32 篇提取 · 6 家机构
共识·6 家机构·32 篇提取·截至 2026-08-08
China's domestic demand weakened in July across manufacturing, property, and consumption, while the Politburo's easing rhetoric has yet to translate into tangible stimulus.7月中国内需在制造业、房地产和消费领域全面走弱，但政治局宽松言论尚未转化为实际刺激。
Most analysts agree that domestic demand weakened in July, but views diverge on whether policy easing will be sufficient to reverse the trend.多数分析师认为7月内需走弱，但对政策宽松是否足以扭转趋势存在分歧。

传导链4 段
Fiscal tightening narrowed the augmented fiscal deficit in H1 2026.2026年上半年财政紧缩收窄了广义财政赤字。→Property starts and land sales revenue fell by 60-80% from their peaks.房地产新开工和土地出让收入从峰值下跌60-80%。→Construction and completions weakened accordingly.施工和竣工随之走弱。→GDP growth slowed from Q1 to Q2, with fiscal contraction contributing nearly half of the deceleration.GDP增速从Q1到Q2放缓，财政紧缩贡献了近一半的减速。

Memory and semiconductor pricing upcycle存储与半导体涨价周期
×7 · 26 步
AI/服务器带来的内存需求明显超过供给，缺口将扩大至2028年；这推动价格上涨（HBM价格同比上涨87%，NAND价格6月上涨23%）和利润率处于高位（DRAM约80%，NAND约60%）。AI推理/智能体应用对NAND的需求显著增加，预计到CY27需求将持续超过供给。内存成本上升给供应链中非内存元器件利润率带来压力，导致非内存元器件面临降本压力。存储供不应求带来定价权：SanDisk已锁定FY27-28超过50%的bit产量，毛利率约80%；Western Digital报告近线HDD已售罄至CY28，每EB价格同比增长18%。DRAM供不应求预计至少持续至2028年Q2，DDR ASP将从2025年的$0.40/Gb升至2027年的$2.24/Gb，HBM ASP升至$3.13/Gb。

AI spillover into factory automationAI溢出至工厂自动化
×6 · 23 步
AI和数据中心需求依然强劲，推动半导体设备和零部件增长，并外溢至工厂自动化和半导体资本设备等相邻行业。日本6月来自中国的机床订单同比增长49.1%（范围广泛），总订单同比增速加快至45.5%（5月为37.3%）；Q2交流伺服和CNC销售额均同比增长25%，6月工业机器人产量同比增长28.1%，形成类似以往周期的‘双峰’形态。WFE市场处于AI驱动的上升周期，随着DRAM和先进逻辑对EUV/HNA采用增加，光刻强度上升；Tokyo Electron将CY27 WFE展望上调至$190bn，并预计涂胶显影/刻蚀设备增长超过50%。
14 篇提取 · 6 家机构
共识·6 家机构·14 篇提取·截至 2026-08-08

×5 · 22 步
AI对服务器、MLCC和CCL的需求导致多个高端电子元器件市场供应紧张并带来定价权：MLCC出口价格环比上涨+4%，CCL价格预计在2H26上调，长约（LTA）承诺已达内存产能的60-70%。MLCC稼动率超过90%，订单出货比升至2.2x。Yageo处于有利位置，随着供应商将产能转向高端，中端产品可能迎来涨价。日本MLCC供需紧张使涨价和合同重新谈判成为可能，部分客户已开始接受涨价以确保供应。

AI server demand is creating supply tightness in high-end MLCCs, CCLs, and memory, with pricing power shifting to suppliers through LTA commitments and price hikes.AI服务器需求导致高端MLCC、CCL和存储器供应紧张，定价权通过长期协议和涨价向供应商转移。

BarclaysCitiGoldman SachsJ.P. MorganMorgan Stanley
Pricing power and cost pass-through variability across sectors定价能力与成本传导的行业差异
×6 · 24 步
各家公司转嫁成本上升的能力不同：Renesas自7月1日起实施涨价，L'Oréal实现销量与销售额增长，而Murata因能源、贵金属和人工成本上升，仅部分考虑调价。各行业公司正通过转嫁更高成本展现定价权，例如Monster Beverage（计划美国提价）、LG Uplus（提高AIDC定价）、GlobalFoundries（定价行动）和Klaviyo（转嫁承运商费用）。AI硬件供需紧张正在推动涨价和利润率扩张：ON Semi提价并将稼动率从77%提升至83%，Wistron重新谈判条款并预期利润率改善。
11 篇提取 · 5 家机构
分歧·5 家机构·11 篇提取·截至 2026-08-07
Companies across sectors show uneven ability to pass on input cost increases: some raise prices and expand margins, while others face margin compression due to incomplete cost pass-through.各行业企业传导成本上涨的能力参差不齐：部分成功提价并扩大利润率，另一些则因传导不充分而面临利润率压缩。
There is wide divergence across sectors: companies like Renesas and ON Semi successfully pass through costs, while Murata and others face challenges in translating pricing adjustments into margin improvement.行业间分歧显著：Renesas和ON Semi等成功传导成本，而Murata等公司在将定价调整转化为利润率改善方面面临挑战。
关键数字77%ON Semi utilization rate in Q1 2026ON Semi 2026年第一季度利用率83%ON Semi utilization rate in Q2 2026ON Semi 2026年第二季度利用率75-80%YoY growth of Murata MLCC sales for AI/DC in Q1Murata AI/DC用MLCC销售同比增长
反方这批报告里的异议
CitiCiti argues that Murata's OPM in the new plan fell below its forecast because the company did not fully pass through cost increases, despite a slight shift in MLCC pricing stance.Citi 指出 Murata 新计划的营业利润率低于其预期，原因是公司并未完全传导成本上涨，尽管MLCC定价立场略有转变。
原文Murata将MLCC定价立场从‘不考虑’调整为‘部分考虑’（R165）；但由于缺乏成本转嫁，新计划中的OPM低于Citi预测（R158）。
传导链5 段
Input cost inflation in energy, raw materials, and labor starts the chain.能源、原材料和劳动力成本上涨启动传导链。→Companies respond with diverging pricing strategies, from full pass-through to partial adjustment.公司以不同的定价策略应对：从完全传导到部分调整。→Pricing decisions directly impact earnings and margin trajectories across sectors.定价决策直接影响各行业的盈利和利润率轨迹。→AI server demand tightens component and assembly supply, granting pricing leverage to suppliers.AI服务器需求收紧零部件和组装供应，赋予供应商定价筹码。→Supply tightness enables margin expansion for companies like ON Semi and Wistron.供应紧张使 ON Semi 和 Wistron 等公司实现利润率扩张。

China NEV & Battery Divergence中国新能源车与电池增长的分化
×5 · 24 步
中国车用电池装机量在1H26同比增长33%，而EV销量仅同比增长10%，主要受电池容量加大（EV-PV +12%、PHEV同比+27%）和商用车份额上升（占装机量23%）推动。BYD新一代刀片电池2.0是关键增长催化剂。中国Q2 2026乘用车（PV）出口同比增长79%，其中EV占出口的54%；而7月国内乘用车零售销量同比下滑约15%，凸显出口强劲与内需疲弱的分化。
5 篇提取 · 5 家机构
共识·5 家机构·5 篇提取·截至 2026-08-04
China's NEV battery installations grew 33% YoY in 1H26 while EV sales rose only 10% YoY, and exports surged 79% yoy in Q2 2026, highlighting a domestic-export divergence.2026年H1中国新能源汽车电池安装量同比增长33%，而电动汽车销量仅增长10%，出口在Q2同比飙升79% yoy，凸显国内与出口的分化。
The market consensus recognizes the divergence between strong battery installation growth and weak domestic EV sales, with exports driving growth.市场共识认识到电池安装量强劲增长与国内电动汽车销量疲软之间的分化，出口驱动增长。

AI positioning unwindAI板块仓位去杠杆
×3 · 12 步
The AI sector correction in July 2026 was driven by an intense positioning unwind after a momentum rally, with hedge funds and retail leverage moderating. Gross leverage reversed half its yearly increase, marking the second-largest 2-day long selling in a decade. AxJ Tech later recovered almost half its July losses. Korea leveraged ETF AUM fell from peak $53bn to $24bn; margin loans declined only 14% from peak while deposits fell 22%, pushing margin-loan-to-deposit ratio from 17% to 26%.
4 篇提取 · 3 家机构
共识·3 家机构·4 篇提取·截至 2026-08-04
The July 2026 AI sector correction was driven by a positioning unwind with hedge fund and retail deleveraging, causing rotation from North Asia to ASEAN/India and from Tech to Discretionary.2026年7月AI板块回调由仓位平仓驱动，对冲基金与散户去杠杆，资金从北亚轮动至东盟与印度，板块从科技轮动至可选消费。
All three firms agree the July 2026 AI correction was driven by positioning deleverage, though specifics differ on rotation and recovery.三家机构均认为2026年7月AI回调由仓位去杠杆驱动，但具体轮动与复苏路径有所不同。

China consumer demand softening中国消费需求整体走弱
×4 · 20 步
多项指标显示中国消费需求走弱：零售销售增速放缓、房地产挂牌量下降、香港去化率走低、服务业PMI回落，奢侈品需大幅打折去库存。例如：Mengniu销售同比-7%，商场餐饮闭店比率0.90，香港CCL周环比-0.4%，Laopu Gold代购提供22%折扣。
4 篇提取 · 4 家机构
共识·4 家机构·4 篇提取·截至 2026-08-06
Consumer demand in China is softening across retail, property, services and luxury, with heavy discounting and weaker activity indicators pointing to broad macroeconomic headwinds.中国消费需求在零售、地产、服务和奢侈品等多个领域走弱，大幅折扣与放缓的活动指标指向宏观逆风。
Analysts broadly agree that China consumer demand is softening, with J.P. Morgan's property evidence providing a partial stabilization counterpoint.分析师总体上认为中国消费需求走弱，J.P. Morgan 的地产证据构成局部企稳的反驳。
关键数字-7% YoYMengniu sales year-on-year change蒙牛销售额同比变化0.90Mall restaurant openings-to-closures ratio in 2Q262026年二季度购物中心餐饮开闭店比-0.4% W/WHong Kong CCL change week on week香港CCL按周变化22%Laopu Gold daigou discount during SKP promotion老铺黄金SKP促销代购折扣15.5Centaline tier-1 cities listing price index, historical low中原一线城市挂牌价指数，历史低位
反方这批报告里的异议
J.P. MorganFalling secondary listings should be read as home price stabilization rather than weakness, and China HY property bonds still rose last week, so the property picture is more mixed than a blanket demand-softening narrative.挂牌减少应被解读为楼价趋稳而非走弱，中资高收益地产债上周仍上涨，房地产图景比笼统的需求走弱叙事更复杂。
传导链5 段
Softening demand starts in retail sales.需求走软首先出现在零售端。→Property listings decline and prices ease.地产挂牌减少、价格松动。→Services activity slows, as the July PMI shows.服务业活动减慢，7月PMI走低。→Luxury brands resort to heavy discounts to clear stock.奢侈品牌靠大幅折扣清库存。→Across sectors, the signals reflect broad macro headwinds.跨行业信号共同反映宏观逆风。

Advantest sees rapid inference AI adoption driving demand across ASICs, CPUs, and DRAM, with customer visibility extending to 18 months. AI chip testing demand in China is projected to grow at an 88% CAGR through 2028, driven by domestic chipmakers accelerating chiplet adoption due to export controls. Teradyne is making progress in winning second-vendor certification from a major hyperscaler (first vendor is Advantest); this would be its second such customer win. AI testing demand benefits Hon Precision as the No.1 test handler maker, with its AI GPU vs. ASIC mix shifting to 50/50 by 2026.

The Fed is 'nakedly dovish', US policymakers will act to prevent Japan/Korea/Taiwan stock weakness from impeding the AI race with China, marking AI PKOs. The coordinated US/Japan/Korea FX intervention was the most important event of the week, short-circuiting risk of JPY collapse, JGB yield melt-up, and disorderly UST flows. Japan's ability to access the Fed's FIMA repo facility allows it to intervene in yen without selling Treasuries outright, with the BoJ/MoF having purchased ~$85bn on July 30-31, the largest 2-day operation since 2011.

    bb107a5cc2d1·《Raimo综述：软件板块大回归之争》·2026-08-02
  4. 4
    结论半导体领先软件趋势未改
    While there have been recent moments of doubt, the overarching trend in semis outperformance over software remains intact.
    尽管近期出现了一些怀疑时刻，但半导体跑赢软件的总体趋势依然完好。
    bb107a5cc2d1·《Raimo综述：软件板块大回归之争》·2026-08-02

反方协调的外汇政策和市场清算相结合通常被视为看涨的‘去杠杆结束’事件，但政策制定者正在微调（试图限制）政府债券收益率，而不是采取货币休克疗法，这就是风险资产在中期内仍受抑制的原因。

    美/日/韩协调外汇干预是本周最重要的事件，政策制定者试图阻断日元崩盘、日债收益率飙升、韩国/台湾债券传染以及无序的利空美国国债资本流动风险；干预效果较好。

    The FAA this week announced it would relax environmental restrictions to enable a higher cadence of space launches, though the assessment related to air traffic would remain; changes should enable more Starship launches but it is not yet clear how the regulatory path will go when thousands of launches are under consideration.

    The case for a multi-trillion dollar valuation is about 'if' not 'when' for orbital data center plans, and quarterly results on August 4th should not matter - what will be important is the level of confidence projected by management regarding growth.

The Trump administration is escalating trade conflicts with new tariffs (50% on Canada, polysilicon duties) and China is retaliating with legal attacks on US tech firms (Palo Alto Networks). These actions heighten uncertainty for global supply chains, particularly in tech and energy, and risk depressing cross-border trade and investment.
